Driver ref of the car behind at the end of ref_lap.

Lap on which the chaser entered the pits.
Lap on which the leader entered the pits.
leader_stop_lap minus chaser_stop_lap. Positive: chaser stopped first (undercut; this is the rival's delay). 0: same lap. Negative: leader stopped first.
Label for delay. Same labels as the coverage audit.
Grouping used by the model and the locked test. d23 pools delays 2 and 3.
Lap before the first of the two stops. All decision-time features are measured at the end of this lap.
The later of the two out-laps. Immediate success is judged at the end of this lap.
chaser_stop_lap + 4: the out-lap after the latest possible rival stop (delay 3). Used whenever different delays are compared.
1 if both drivers are on the same team. Excluded from the core cohort; kept for the sensitivity check.

1 if clean_window = 1, teammates = 0, delay in 1..3 and 0 < gap_before_sec <= 6. The primary model is fitted only on these rows.
Chaser crossing time minus leader crossing time at the end of ref_lap. Always positive (the chaser is behind).
Chaser tyre age at ref_lap (TyreLife).
Leader tyre age at ref_lap.
chaser_tyre_age minus leader_tyre_age. Positive: the chaser's tyres are older.
Cars crossing the line between the two drivers at the end of ref_lap.
Median matched pit-lane time at the circuit, from training seasons only. A circuit first raced after 2023 uses the median of its first race.
Cars crossing the line within 2.0 s ahead of the first stopper at the end of the first stopper's out-lap (any lap count). See DECISIONS D-005.
Green-flag on-track position changes per car-lap at the circuit, excluding pit in and out laps, from training seasons only.
1 if the circuit has no training-season races and overtaking_difficulty is the training-season median over all circuits.
Car regulation era. post2022 covers 2022 onwards.
Pit-lane time of whichever driver stopped first (extension 1). Measured after the decision.
first_stopper_pitlane_sec minus the race median pit-lane time (extension 1).
Compound fitted by the chaser relative to the compounds used at that event (extension 3).

Chaser crossing time minus leader crossing time at the end of comparison_lap. Negative means the chaser is ahead.
